items.q: the last time I saw him... Hey, Hap. I said, what do you say, King? And we started to talking.

ctx.x: Oh, definitely. You know, there was so many -- the last time I saw him, he was living up there with his family on 154th Street -- 151st Street, right around the Masonic Temple. So I'm up there-- I had a group up there -- 158th Street, playing for dances, club dates, and there was a big supermarket, and Hawk drive up there with his Chrysler station wagon. Hey, Hap.
